accom_shared_hostel_dorm.sourceTitle: Hostels in Bangkok from $4 - Hotels | Hostelz.com
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.evidenceText: On average, hostels in Bangkok cost around $4 per dorm bed and $30 per private room per night.
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.referencePeriod: Hostelz price-statistics page; published 7 months ago and crawled 3 weeks before 2026-07-31; dates and tax treatment not stated
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.searchQuery: site:hostelz.com Bangkok Thailand hostel dorm bed average nightly price
accom_shared_hostel_dorm.reason: The exact Bangkok Hostelz page gives a numeric city-level average for a dorm bed, not a from/lowest quote. A dorm bed is a one-adult sleeping unit; no two-traveller scaling was performed. The page's private-room figure was not used because two-adult occupancy is not explicit.

accom_hostel_private_room.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Bangkok Thailand hostel private room average nightly price
accom_hostel_private_room.reason: Budget Your Trip exposed an exact Bangkok private-room average of $19 based on 366 hostels and guesthouses, but neither the result nor the independent Hostelz result explicitly establishes two-adult/two-guest occupancy. The strict private-room contract therefore fails closed.
